t: This is St Mary's Hospital in Paddington, a teaching hospital founded in 1845 and now run by Imperial College Healthcare NHS Trust. It is best known for who was born here. Prince William and Prince Harry were both born in this hospital. So were William's children: Prince George, Princess Charlotte and Prince Louis. Charlotte and Louis were born during the reign of Queen Elizabeth II. The actor Kiefer Sutherland, known as Jack Bauer in the series 24, was also born here, in 1966.
